en.topic_title: Greenpeace warns of growing overtourism after recording thousands of National Day visitors at Hong Kong eco-sites
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s Greenpeace office has warned of growing overtourism after it recorded thousands of visitors and dozens of instances of environmental damage at local ecotourism hotspots in a single day during mainland China’s weeklong National Day break.



A boy holds a sea cucumber at Half Moon Bay, on Oct 4, 2026. Photo: Greenpeace Hong Kong.
